context: Tests whether the agent produces the correct output directory structure (report.md, result.json, reproducibility/commands.sh), includes the required report sections (gene profile table, drug summary, clinical alerts), classifies drugs into AVOID/CAUTION/STANDARD/INSUFFICIENT, and includes a medical disclaimer.

checklist.name: report.md present
checklist.description: A file named report.md exists inside the output directory

checklist.name: result.json present
checklist.description: A file named result.json exists inside the output directory

checklist.name: commands.sh present
checklist.description: A file named commands.sh exists inside output_directory/reproducibility/

checklist.name: Gene profile table
checklist.description: report.md contains a gene profile table listing genes and their diplotypes/phenotypes

checklist.name: Drug summary section
checklist.description: report.md contains a drug summary or drug recommendations section

checklist.name: Clinical alerts section
checklist.description: report.md contains a clinical alerts or actionable alerts section

checklist.name: AVOID classification used
checklist.description: report.md or result.json uses the classification label AVOID (or avoid) for at least one drug

checklist.name: CAUTION classification used
checklist.description: report.md or result.json uses the classification label CAUTION (or caution) for at least one drug

checklist.name: STANDARD classification used
checklist.description: report.md or result.json uses the classification label STANDARD (or standard) for at least one drug

checklist.name: Medical disclaimer
checklist.description: report.md contains a disclaimer section stating the report is for research/educational purposes and should not replace clinical advice

checklist.name: No external packages
checklist.description: pharmgx_tool.py does NOT import any non-standard-library packages (e.g. no pandas, numpy, biopython, requests)
